title: Gamification: Toward a Definition
why: Defines gamification as use of game design elements in non-game contexts, distinct from serious games.
finding: Clear definition separates gamification (game elements in non-game context) from serious games (complete games for non-entertainment)

title: Superhuman: 1:1 Onboarding as Growth Engine
why: 1:1 personalized onboarding combined with fast product to guide users to aha moment within minutes.
finding: 1:1 onboarding improved activation by 17% with synthetic inbox; ~10K customers annually from 12 onboarding specialists
